register.title: Request a Bikri shop
register.subtitle: Tell us about your shop. We review every request before creating a shop.
register.intro: After you submit, we review your request. If it passes the first review, we ask Cloudflare to send a verification email to this address. Click the link in that email; your registration code is issued only after the email is verified and the request is approved. The email comes from Cloudflare, not Bikri.
register.privacy: We use these details only to review your request and contact you. Do not submit someone else’s email.
register.success_body: We’ll review it first. If it looks good, watch for an email from Cloudflare and click the verification link. Your registration code has not been issued yet.
register.error_rate: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
register.error_generic: Could not send the request. Try again.
register.status_awaiting_email: Check your email — Cloudflare verification sent
register.status_approved: Approved — your registration code was sent to your email/WhatsApp
register.status_missing_body: Open the status link from your request confirmation.
